title: Human Liver Tissue Dissociation for 10x Single Cell RNA-seq
author: Ankur Sharma
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vhue36w
materials: **Before tumor arrives** Prepare all buffers fresh on the day of experiment - Prepare dissociation buffer (2x) Collagenase IV (Gibco 17104-109) - 4.3mg for 10ml of RPMI Add 50µl of DNAseI **Sterile filterand keep it at 37 °C ** ** 5 ml of (2x) dissociation buffer + 5 ml of RPMI (without serum) per tumor ** - Prepare Liver Dissociation Buffer -15 g BSA 1 ml EDTA (0.5M) 500ml DPBS **Sterile filterand keep it at 4 °C ** - Prepare Liver Dissociation Buffer-2 0.1 g BSA 100ml DPBS **Sterile filterand keep it at 4 °C ** -Prepare 70µ & 40µ filters, 15 & 50 ml falcons and surgical blades, RBC lysis buffer

**Before tumor arrives** Prepare all buffers fresh on the day of experiment - Prepare dissociation buffer (2x) Collagenase IV (Gibco 17104-109) - 4.3mg for 10ml of RPMI Add 50µl of DNAseI **Sterile filterand keep it at 37 °C ** ** 5 ml of (2x) dissociation buffer + 5 ml of RPMI (without serum) per tumor ** - Prepare Liver Dissociation Buffer -15 g BSA 1 ml EDTA (0.5M) 500ml DPBS **Sterile filterand keep it at 4 °C ** - Prepare Liver Dissociation Buffer-2 0.1 g BSA 100ml DPBS **Sterile filterand keep it at 4 °C ** -Prepare 70µ & 40µ filters, 15 & 50 ml falcons and surgical blades, RBC lysis buffer

steps.title: Tissue Preparation and Initial Dissociation
steps.instruction: Process the tumor tissue to obtain a single-cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Verify tumor arrival in MACS Tissue Storage Solution (130-100-008).
Transfer tissue into a 10cm dish containing 5ml of warm RPMI media.
Cut tissue into small pieces using scalpels.
Transfer chopped tumor (5ml in RPMI) into a 50ml falcon tube with 5ml of 2x dissociation buffer.
Incubate at 37 °C for 40 hours.
Re-suspend gently using a 10ml pipette followed by a 16G needle.

steps.title: Cell Filtration and RBC Lysis
steps.instruction: Filter the dissociated tissue and remove red blood cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 25ml of cold Buffer-1 and pour the content through a 70µ strainer into a new 50ml falcon tube.
Rinse the strainer with 10ml of Buffer-1.
Discard the strainer and centrifuge at 800g for 6 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant and add 5ml of 1x RBC lysis buffer (BioLegend 420301) to cells; incubate for 5 minutes on ice.
Add 10ml of Buffer-1 and centrifuge at 800g for 6 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard supernatant and add 5ml of Buffer-1.
Pour content through a 40µ strainer into a new 15ml falcon tube and rinse the strainer with 5ml of Buffer-1.
Centrifuge at 800g for 6 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dead Cell Removal
steps.instruction: Remove dead cells using the Miltenyi Kit (130-090-101).

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1x binding buffer by diluting 20x binding buffer solution.
Collect cells by centrifuging at 300g and remove supernatant.
Re-suspend cells in dead cell removal microbeads, mix well, and incubate for 15 minutes at 25 °C.
Prepare an LD column in a MACS separator by rinsing with 2ml of 1x binding buffer.
Apply cell suspension onto the column and rinse with 2ml of 1x binding buffer.
Collect the effluent as the live cell fraction.
Centrifuge at 800g for 6 minutes at 4 °C and dissolve the cell pellet in Buffer-2.

steps.title: CD45+ Cell Depletion
steps.instruction: Separate CD45+ and CD45- cells using MACS buffer and microbeads.

substeps.instruction: Prepare MACS buffer (PBS pH 7.2, 0.5% BSA, 2 mM EDTA), sterile filter, and store at 4 °C.
Resuspend up to 10^7 cells in 80 μl of MACS buffer and add 20 μl CD45 microbeads (130-045-801).
Mix by pipetting 10 times and incubate for 15 minutes at 4 °C.
Add 2ml of MACS buffer and centrifuge at 800g for 6 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1ml of MACS buffer.
Prepare an LD column in a MACS separator by rinsing with 2ml of MACS buffer.
Apply cell suspension onto the column and rinse twice with 2ml of MACS buffer.
Collect 4ml of effluent as the CD45 negative cell fraction.
Plunge the column with 2ml of MACS buffer and collect this effluent as the CD45 positive cell fraction.
Count the CD45+ and CD45- cell fractions at least three times using two different cell counters.

steps.title: Sample Preparation for 10x RNA-seq
steps.instruction: Balance the cell populations to increase hepatocyte representation.

substeps.instruction: Add equal numbers of CD45+ and CD45- cells to achieve a final concentration of 1000 cells/μl in a total of 100μl solution.
Count cells at least twice on two different cell counters.
Proceed to 10x experiment.
